name: Syter-Viterskalet
description: Syter to Viterskalet. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Main-route natural water: The route crosses/follows Svärfarbäcken, Västra Syterbäcken/Syterbäcken and side streams. Hut pages describe guests fetching water from stream/lake. Treat as natural water, not a built tap.
Syter hut / Svärfarbäcken water: Syter hut guests fetch natural water from stream/lake. Treat/purify as needed.

Syterskalet streams / Syterbäcken: Main route follows or crosses watercourses including Svärfarbäcken and Syterbäcken/Västra Syterbäcken. Field reports repeatedly mention reliable streams and camping by water.
Viterskalet hut natural water: STF hut guests fetch water from stream/lake under the standard mountain-cabin routine. Not a treated tap.
notes: Final runtime source/licensing/capture policy for Naturvårdsverket, Naturkartan and OSM/Waymarked.
Endpoint snapping/splitting policy at Viterskalet shared boundary with section 27.
Confirm exact final AC3 clipping point and coordinate transformation in import tooling.
If importing standalone facilities, use Naturvårdsverket Anordningar as the primary coordinate source for Syterskalet/Viterskalet toilet, bridge and help-phone points and keep OSM only as QA.
Treat Viterskalet capacity as 32 guest beds from current STF descriptive text unless a future live recheck changes the page.
Keep Viterskalet sauna suppressed unless a future official source adds it.
Refresh live currentness before import: Länsstyrelsen closures/bridges, STF hut dates/services, fire bans, SMHI forecasts/warnings and transit timetables.

facilities.name: STF Syter Fjällstuga cluster
facilities.description: Shared northern endpoint. Staffed STF hut in season with old/safety room, help phone, toilets, wood/self-service water routines, pets in limited rooms. No current official shop or sauna.
facilities.routeProximity: Section start / shared endpoint with section 25.

facilities.name: Bridge west of Syter / Svärfarbäcken bridge
facilities.description: Bridge over Svärfarbäcken just west of STF Syter. STF explicitly says the stage crosses Svärfarbäcken by the bridge just west of the hut; Naturvårdsverket Anordningar confirms a hanging bridge on AC3 at 65.892310,15.394974.
facilities.routeProximity: Immediately after Syter on main route.

facilities.name: Syterskalet rastskydd
facilities.description: Official Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan rest shelter in Syterskalet. Naturvårdsverket Anordningar confirms Rastskydd on AC3. Temporary rest only; no overnight except mountain-safety need. Has help-phone activity tag, emergency box and emergency wood replenished by Länsstyrelsen in winter.
facilities.routeProximity: On or very near main route in Syterskalet.

facilities.name: Syterskalet rastskydd toilet
facilities.description: Official Naturvårdsverket Anordningar Dass point associated with AC3 and located about 73 m from the Syterskalet shelter coordinate. Treat OSM's nearby mapped toilet as QA only.

facilities.name: Syterskalet / Syterbäcken bridge
facilities.description: Official Naturvårdsverket Anordningar bridge on AC3 in the Syterskalet/Syterbäcken area. This resolves the earlier OSM-only bridge caveat.

facilities.name: Tent/camping near Viterskalet
facilities.description: Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen section page says there are many good tent sites closer to Viterskalsstugan. No discrete official tent-site coordinate found.

facilities.name: STF Viterskalet Fjällstuga cluster
facilities.description: Endpoint STF hut on Kungsleden. Current STF text says 32 guest beds, self-catering kitchen, drying room, wash room, dog/safety room, water/wood self-service routine and shop with large assortment. No current official sauna found.

facilities.name: Viterskalet shop
facilities.description: STF Viterskalet page lists a shop in the small cabin with large assortment; STF shop page lists Viterskalet among hut shops.

facilities.name: Viterskalet safety room
facilities.description: Naturkartan says the first room on the right in the main cabin is an open safety room outside STF season and also dog room. STF says one 4-bed room is used as safety room.

facilities.description: Official help phone point in the Viterskalet endpoint cluster, associated with AC3 and AC8.
